method: Gradient-free causal MLP localization, weight-column geometry and selective readout-component projection; no optimizer, LoRA or backward pass.
localization: Bypass each MLP output in turn on all sixteen paired diagnostic decisions. Rank by balanced binary log-loss, with a penalty for new wrong negative decisions. This is a diagnostic activation intervention, not the retained weight edit.
projection: Choose only columns whose mean actual present-act contribution points toward false. Rank by that contribution minus mean absolute influence on absent-act examples. Remove the native false-readout component from 64 eligible columns.
selection: Select layer/dose using the 16 original and 32 retired development proposals only, prioritizing unsupported acts, full matches, missing acts and diagnostic loss. The new 32-case test is reserved.
controls: Matched dequantized-only sham, same-column norm-matched random direction, reversed projection and identity. No output embedding or final norm edits.
gate: >=27/32 fresh complete outcomes, >=6 extra matches versus matched sham, no additional unsupported acts, no copied/injection false report, no unrelated-control regression. Agent-authored data never suffices for automatic live promotion.
privacy: Invented sources only, offline local inference, background task policy, no production model writes or private records.
testPolicy: Fresh test fixed before inspection. Choose from development only; run each fixed variant once on fresh test. All inspected sets become regression data.
diagnostics: Use each untouched model-generated JSON prefix; likelihood aggregates bare and leading-space true/false tokens. Require exact replay of every native greedy Boolean. Readout geometry uses the dominant native token variant.
previousRunStatus: The 64-column edit had a development directional effect but no change in any fresh act set: all four variants 14/32. That test is now additional development material.
coverageReason: 64 columns cover 34.47% and 512 cover 81.32% of eligible positive contrast-score sum. This is a proxy, not semantic error coverage.
